summary: FD_ED_TC_27_Reporting | Currency Conversion | CAD Equivalent Logged | EU Regime | EUR to CAD
title: Reporting | Currency Conversion | CAD Equivalent Logged | EU Regime | EUR to CAD
description:
Per call transcript: "The Canadian equivalent of compensation amounts should be logged for reporting, and conversion rates should be standardized for exposure analysis." This TC validates that when compensation is in EUR (EU regime), the system logs both the EUR amount AND the CAD equivalent with the conversion rate used.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED26; 1 leg AC (CDG?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; EU EL-01 (�600); Customer resides in France; Payment in EUR; CAD/EUR exchange rate available
